facts.fact: The government information service reports that the digital transition minister launched the ATI platform on 2 April 2024, where firms apply online for the IT technical accreditation, track the request and verify an issued accreditation.

The minister said the ATI platform launched on 2 April 2024 was developed in-house, and congratulated the ministry's information systems directorate and the digital transformation directorate general.
The minister said the ATI platform was developed in-house by the ministry's own directorates, naming no contractor.

BFA.note: The document states nothing on schools.
